payload.body: 0123 WITH 0127 AND 0129 IS READY FOR YOUR REVIEW, as one commit on top of 0120. WHAT IT DOES: publish removes from the install what the source stopped shipping (0123); install --force retires from a project what the previous manifest recorded and the source no longer ships (0129), through one removal, remove_unshipped; and every read of the vendored set reads find's status, with its error left on stderr, so an unreadable source refuses rather than vendoring short (0127). EVIDENCE: 12 arms; at 0113's landing every arm but three is red for its reason, the class scan red on its floor, and the unrecorded-file and manifest-guard arms green by construction and proved by mutants. 15 mutants killed: V1-V10 (mut0123/) and W1-W5 (mut0129/). On 2b9d1a5 plus 0120 plus 0123, the 21 files that run install, upgrade or doctor or name the vendored set: 1..829, 829 ok, 0 not ok, 0 skips, rc 0, 13:42:13Z to 13:59:32Z (files0123r.tap and .meta). NOT RE-RUN since 0113's landing: the critic, on bytes the rebase did not change. FILED since my last message: 0137 (clean's drop_nested, built with 0131) and 0139 (the find class, three sites driven: infra profiles says no domain claimed twice with a profile unread, devbin's own syntax gate passes 47 files and 0 breaches over a planted breach it could not read, and cargo_target_dirs ends its caller silently). 0139 lists 0127's four sites as fixed by this commit.
